title: Giving Thanks
summary:
Giving Thanks
For many, the Thanksgiving holiday in the United States is characteristically a time for gathering with friends and family and hopefully reflecting upon a successful year. 2006 is certainly another year that has exceeded many peoples' expectations. For those in the tanker industry, there is much for which to be thankful.

children.title: Reasons to Give Thanks
children.summary: As we sit in front of our televisions tomorrow and watch football (American style) and eat copious quantities of turkey and trimmings, we can reflect on the following reasons to be thankful:
